stockage.title: Object storage
stockage.description:
The S3-compatible bucket the daily report is written to. The endpoint is read from the provider's console, on the bucket itself.

**Leave every field empty if the bucket does not exist yet.** Collection runs, the report is written to disk, and nothing is uploaded. Add the storage later through Reconfigure.

data_description.s3_prefixe: Optional. Files every report under a common path, useful when the bucket serves more than one purpose.

user.title: Media
user.description:
What the collector will read. Three of them need no credentials at all.

**Reddit** is the only one that does, and its door has closed: reddit.com refuses an anonymous client at the network layer. **Arctic Shift** serves the same posts through a third party that does allow it — two days behind, the time it takes for scores to mean something.

reddit.title: Reddit
reddit.description:
A registered client (reddit.com/prefs/apps) if you have one: a token only reads. Otherwise leave both fields empty — the next screen takes a session cookie.

The declared agent is required either way.

data_description.reddit_user_agent: Expected shape: platform:identifier:version (by /u/account). A generic agent gets throttled.

cookies.title: Session cookies
cookies.description:
Paste what your browser exports, in **any of three formats**: the header line `name=value; name=value`, a browser-extension JSON export (Cookie-Editor), or a `cookies.txt` file. Cookies from another site are dropped, and the expiry is kept when the export carries it.

Clearing the field removes the stored cookie.

data_description.x_cookie: Must carry `auth_token` **and** `ct0`, both. The first carries the session, the second is echoed as the anti-CSRF header — X refuses the request without it.
data_description.reddit_cookie: `reddit_session` **or** `token_v2` — either one is enough. `old.reddit.com` sets the first, the current interface sets the second, and an export often carries only the one from the frontend you signed in through.

reauth_confirm.description:
The session is no longer recognised — {etat}.

Export it again from a browser signed in to the studio account and paste it here. Nothing is collected from this medium until you do.

error.reddit_refuse: Reddit refused these credentials. Check that the application is a confidential client and that the declared agent is not generic.
error.reddit_bride: Reddit is throttling this client right now. Try again in a minute.
error.reddit_injoignable: Reddit is unreachable from this installation.
error.stockage_refuse: Storage refused: no such bucket, or keys without rights on it.
error.stockage_injoignable: The endpoint is unreachable. Check its spelling.
error.stockage_incomplet: Storage is half filled in. Either all five fields, or none of them — four out of five is an interrupted entry, not an intention.
error.aucun_media: At least one medium is needed. Without one, a run reads nothing.
error.cookie_illisible: This is none of the three known formats. Expected: the header line, a browser-extension JSON export, or a cookies.txt file.
error.cookie_incomplet: The export carries no usable session cookie. Reddit takes `reddit_session` or `token_v2`; X requires both `auth_token` and `ct0`. Check the export comes from a signed-in tab, not a private window.
error.sans_porte: A selected medium still has nothing to read it with. Reddit takes a registered client or a cookie, X takes a cookie. Untick it, or paste its session.

reglages.title: Pace and bounds of one run
reglages.description: Reddit grants a registered client 100 requests per minute, so a hundred sources fit inside one minute of budget. The default rate spends less than a third of it and keeps the rest for retries.

data_description.budget_secondes: Past this delay the report ships with what it has, unread sources are named, and they move to the front of the queue on the next run.
data_description.garder_brut: The archive is raw: dropping the original payload makes files smaller and cannot be undone after the fact.
data_description.decalage_jours: Arctic Shift captures a post at creation then captures it again later: on day 0 every score is 1, by day 3 they have matured. Ranking yesterday would rank zeros.
data_description.disposition: What listing a prefix returns. By medium: everything one source produced. By date: everything that landed on a given day, all media together.
data_description.agent:
What the collector announces to RSS, Arctic Shift, Hacker News and Lobsters. Reddit keeps its own, entered separately: its API demands a specific shape and refuses a generic agent.

The default names itself and carries an address, so an operator who wants to know who is reading can write. What you put instead is your call.
data_description.x_query_compte: Leave empty unless it breaks. X publishes no API for this: the endpoints read are its own web interface, and their query ids change on every build. A 404 on every X source means they rotated — they are fixed here, without waiting for a release.
data_description.x_query_recherche: Required for a a « q: » source source, and it has no default: nobody measured it, so nothing is written in its place. It is read once from the inspector of a logged-in tab, Network panel, on a search run by hand: the SearchTimeline request carries it in its path. Left empty, searches go mute saying so; followed accounts keep working.
